W.note: Clean zinc-neutral catalog with aligned Add to cart rows, working search, chips, sort, drawer with steppers and a status toast, though the initials tiles are generic and the mobile tiles are very tall.

X.note: Strong variant, stock, pending and error handling with a labeled bag drawer, but the desktop leaves most of the canvas empty and the Add to bag buttons sit at different heights across the three cards.

Y.note: The densest and most restrained option, with product-specific line-art glyphs, size chips and a sold-out state, but the sweater's size row wraps and throws its button out of line and the red Sold out text reads as an error.

Z.note: The most complete feature set (persistent cart, free-shipping hint, clear cart, sticky summary) with tidy alignment, but it is a conventional sidebar template with large cards that wastes space and pushes the cart below the fold on phones.
